title: Final Expression for B
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the magnetic field B must be correctly derived and presented in terms of E, e, and R.

title: Numerical Calculation of B
description: Important Criteria: The numerical value of B must be accurately calculated using the provided values for E and R.

title: Final Expression for Delta E/E
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the energy loss ratio Delta E/E must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Numerical Calculation of Delta E/E
description: Important Criteria: The numerical value of Delta E/E must be accurately calculated using the provided values for E and R.

title: Use of Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly recall and use universal constants in their calculations.

title: Sign and Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid common errors related to sign mistakes or unit inconsistencies in calculations.
